title: It’s a ripoff that doesn’t properly work
body:
The app constantly crashes, there’s no way to create a profile and save information and the app isn’t synchronizing between devices.
Also a 19.99 “lifetime” subscription is actually count as monthly and was charged after I cancelled the subscription all together!

So don’t waste your time and money!
author: riki_black

title: I love HabitBox
body: This app helps me to be a more disciplined person!  I use HabitBox every day and reach incredible heights!
author: sudarieva
